items.title: 2 reasons why Microsoft belongs in your portfolio: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria
items.summary: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to explain why Microsoft (MSFT) is a top AI stock, arguing that its multi-year access to OpenAI’s technology and the rise of open-source models make owning a proprietary frontier model unnecessary.

items.title: S&P 500 Q2 Earnings: Stripping Out the Outsized Impact of Alphabet and Micron
items.summary: The picture emerging from Q2 earnings is one of broad-based strength. Companies are comfortably beating consensus estimates-even as those forecasts were revised upward leading into the reporting cycle-while the overall pace of earnings growth continues to accelerate noticeably.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Plunges To 4-Week Low; Metals Firm Kaiser Hits New Entry (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Nasdaq composite led a wide-ranging sell-off the entire session as the Iran-U.S. war intensified and grew in complexity. Blue chips offered no safe haven either, as the Dow Jones Industrial Average moved sharply lower Thursday.

items.title: Why Nvidia Stock Isn’t Rallying as It Should After Alphabet Earnings
items.summary: The Google parent’s results have provided fuel for a rally in chip stocks, but Nvidia has been left behind.

items.title: Micron, SK Hynix Stocks Rise After Google Earnings. Here’s Why.
items.summary: Micron and SK Hynix shares rose Thursday following Alphabet’s earnings report and capital expenditure guidance.

items.title: Dow Dives 506 Points as Alphabet Stock Sinks: Stock Market Today
items.summary: Rising bond yields and worries over increased spending from mega caps Alphabet and Tesla put pressure on the broader stock market on Thursday.

items.title: Micron gains as Musk thanks it for  ’significant’ memory chip allocation
items.summary: Micron (NASDAQ: MU) shares rose 3.1% in intra-day action Thursday following the comments as investors interpreted the endorsement as confirmation of a deepening strategic supply relationship. The move is in stark contrast to Tesla, which is down 14.3% following an earnings miss, negative free cash flow and weak auto margins.

items.summary: Google just gave investors another reason to love Micron stock.
